question: How many data scientists will AIMS Cameroon send out when it closes the academic year featuring Patrice Takam's workshop?
answer: When we close this academic year, we shall thus send with confidence fifteen data scientists who can design and monitor statistical studies, as well as extract and report actionable insight from the data collected.
